pr.title: Apply restock events to stock levels
pr.body: Consumes a restock event and adds its quantity to the product's stock row. Refs #2
pr.author: dev

migrations.content:
CREATE TABLE products (
    product_id uuid NOT NULL,
    warehouse_id uuid NOT NULL,
    sku text NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT uq_products_warehouse_id_sku UNIQUE (warehouse_id, sku),
    PRIMARY KEY (product_id)
);
